notes.title: Want to fight against others online? Try 'Parsec'!
notes.content:
Parsec allows you to play local multiplayer games with others online, and it's free! Check it out here: https://ui.parsecgaming.com/

Enjoy the game the way it was meant to be played!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34470654/33057356b90d910da9d579760d4f0f211c056ddd.jpg[/img]
